summary: Validates the zero/non-zero run-length pattern of a 40-by-41 triangular sweep over an array of double rows (a1 points to an array of row pointers; row i scans elements i..39 of row i). Walks the rows with a shrinking window, accumulating run lengths of consecutive equal zero-ness, and requires each completed run to equal the matching entry of a hardcoded 84-word pattern table. Returns true only when every expected transition was consumed and the final in-progress run length equals 194.

local_names.a1: pointer to array of 41 row pointers (each row an array of doubles)
local_names.a2: expected element count per row, checked against 40
local_names.v6: walker over the row-pointer array starting at a1
local_names.v7: pattern index consumed per completed run
local_names.v8: accumulator of the current run length
local_names.v9: expected zero/non-zero flag for the current run (starts true)
local_names.v10: copy of the row index used as the inner element bound
local_names.v11: current double element within the row

operations.description: Initialize the 84-entry hardcoded run-length pattern table v5[0..83] with word literals from the data segment (values between 0 and 194).
Reset the pattern index v7=0, the run-length accumulator v8=0, and the expected zero/non-zero flag v9=1 (starts expecting a non-zero element).
Return false immediately when the row element count a2 != 40.
Outer do-while walks the row-pointer array (reached through this+0x0 / *a1) for v2 from 1 while v2 < 41, i.e. 41 row slots.
Inner do-while scans the current row's doubles starting at element index v2 (8-byte stride) while the element index < 40, producing a shrinking window per row.
Compare the current element's zero-ness (*v11 != 0.0) with the expected flag v9 to detect whether the current run has transitioned.
At a run transition, return false if the pattern index v7 has reached 83, meaning the expected pattern is exhausted early.
Compare the completed run length v8 against the pattern entry v5[v7]; a mismatch returns false.
Commit a validated run: advance the pattern index v7, reset the run-length accumulator v8=0, and flip the expected zero/non-zero flag v9=!v9.
While the element's zero-ness still matches the expected flag, increment the run-length accumulator v8.
Return true only when the pattern was fully consumed (v7 == 82) and the final in-progress run length equals 194.
